dedupe_keys.name: kalimati fruits and vegetable market yearly reports kathmandu wholesale prices monthly arrival volumes and volumes by source district

description: Kalimati is the wholesale fruit and vegetable market for Kathmandu, and its development board publishes a yearly workbook of market statistics. Each workbook has a price sheet giving the minimum, maximum and average wholesale price per kilogram of every traded commodity for each Nepali month, a sheet of monthly arrival volumes by commodity, and a sheet showing where arrivals came from, by district of origin such as Chitwan, Bhaktapur and Kathmandu. Reports for the Nepali years 2080, 2081 and 2082 are free to download as Excel files from the market's home page. Together they show the flows of fresh food into the capital, how prices swing with the seasons, and how much the city relies on particular producing districts. Caveats: the Nepali text is in a legacy font encoding that displays as Latin characters without conversion, months follow the Nepali calendar, only three years are linked, and no licence is stated. Coverage is one market. Simulation uses: modelling Kathmandu's fresh food supply network and the effect of road closures from landslides or floods on arrivals and prices. Related records: Statistical Information on Nepalese Agriculture (data-nepal-statistical-information-on-nepalese-agriculture) gives the district production behind these arrivals.
